risks.title: Conflicting parallel implementation
risks.cause: Multiple workers may be scheduled against overlapping code or semantic resources
risks.consequence: changes are lost, authority becomes ambiguous, or integration fails

mitigations.description: Enforce one writer per Work Unit, write-scope conflicts, resource locks, WIP limits, and actor capacity.
Verify the live PR diff remains inside the declared write scope before merge-ready gating and merge.

risks.review_trigger: planning, lease, scope, resource-lock, or parallel scheduling semantics change

risks.title: Stale integration evidence after base movement
risks.cause: Another parallel Work Unit may merge after a candidate has passed CI and independent review
risks.event: the target branch changes while the candidate head remains unchanged
risks.consequence: previous evidence no longer proves compatibility with the current integration base

mitigations.description: Bind merge-ready evidence to both exact head SHA and exact base SHA and require revalidation after base drift.

risks.review_trigger: merge, gate, CI merge-candidate, or base-update semantics change

risks.title: Non-reproducible autonomous planning
risks.cause: Priority or conflict decisions may depend on hidden, unstable, or non-versioned state
risks.event: identical planning inputs produce different execution decisions
risks.consequence: auditability and predictable autonomous operation are lost

mitigations.description: Use deterministic versioned inputs, stable tie breakers, and repeatable planner self-tests.

risks.review_trigger: priority formula, tie breaker, dependency, or conflict semantics change
